assignments.title: Binary Search Tree Operations
assignments.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
assignments.description: Implement a Binary Search Tree (BST) supporting insert(val), search(val), and in_order_traversal(). Optimize for clean recursion and edge handling (empty tree, duplicates).

assignments.title: Dijkstra Shortest Path Algorithm
assignments.subject: Advanced Algorithms
assignments.description: Implement Dijkstra's Single Source Shortest Path on a weighted directed graph using a Min-Heap / Priority Queue. Handle disconnected graphs gracefully.

assignments.title: Find Greatest of Two Numbers
assignments.subject: Programming Fundamentals
assignments.description: Write a program to accept two integers from standard input and output the greatest of the two numbers.
assignments.problemStatement: Write a program that takes two integers separated by whitespace or newline as input and prints the greater of the two numbers to standard output.
assignments.inputFormat: Two space or newline separated integers, A and B.
assignments.outputFormat: A single integer representing the maximum of A and B.
